_comment: DRISHTI Catalyst billing Budget/Report descriptor (Phase 14 Part B credit monitoring). Catalyst exposes NO CLI billing/usage command and the CLI login carries no billing scope (verified Part A, report §9), so budget alerts + usage reports are configured in Console -> Billing/Budget. This file is the reviewed source of the thresholds an operator applies there. No monetary values are secret; amounts are the hackathon plan baseline.

budget_alerts_inr.action: email owner; pause non-essential enable flags (DRISHTI_*_ENABLED)
email owner; stop temporary AWS GPU/Batch; freeze new deploys

cost_controls: cron_reconcile stops temporary AWS GPU/Batch + emits budget/health evidence (workflow §17)
development Data Store imports capped at 5000 rows/table
review_cadence: cron_reconcile nightly attaches a budget/health evidence line; operator reviews the Console usage report weekly.
